description: The Audio is our first ever 22” Frame. There is no denying the momentum of the 22” movement; the larger diameter wheel provides a more stable ride without sacrificing the classic BMX look and feel. Perfect for the die-hard trail dogs, or taller riders looking for bike more fitting to their size, without having to ride a bike that simply isn’t a BMX. Using a full Chromoly aftermarket spec frame and fork, we spent an incredibly long time dialling in the geometry on the audio, as well as developing our own range of 22” specific parts like the (logic) rim and (overbite) tire. The 22” revolution is here, and the audio is leading the pack.
